summary: Stone County, Missouri lookout tower, 99 ft, erected about three years before 1939; its ranger died in a fall in Dec 1939. Fate and site today not found.

events.note: Approximate: the Dec. 1939 report says the tower was erected three years earlier. No build date was found in a source.
Jess Peterson was ranger in charge and had held the post since the tower was erected.
Ranger Jess Peterson died after a fall from the top of the tower on Saturday, Dec. 9, 1939.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Missouri has two Pilot Knob lookouts. The Phelps County tower (NHLR US 1773) is a different structure from this Stone County lookout, and its entry is used only for the existence note.

notes_for_editor: Built year 1936 is derived from 'three years ago' in a Dec. 1939 report and is marked approximate; no construction record was read. Fate, current status, access and site condition were not found in any source. The Central US Lookouts index also has pilot-knob.html (Phelps County, 36N), which is a separate tower and was not used. Web searches were exhausted for this run before the fate and Mark Twain National Forest history could be checked, so a later pass could add removal or survey records.
